scope: Six new authored sheets, two humans and two Yautja. Per-character source measurements preserved.

source.background: Opaque varying magenta; no alpha conversion performed.

measurementMethod.separation: Full-width column projection in each half-height row, split by twelve consecutive empty columns; no fixed-width clipping.
measurementMethod.keyClassifier: Background iff r>=threshold and b>=threshold and g<=120 and r-g>=70 and b-g>=70. Thresholds160/180/200. This only measures pixels; it does not modify them.
measurementMethod.boundsPolicy: Union of three threshold bounds plus eight pixels of margin.
measurementMethod.pivotPolicy: Midpoint of two measured boot sole contact spans, at the lower sole baseline; constant scale1. Sole span is the union of foreground pixels in each boot's bottom four rows, after separating the lower60px boot bands by largest empty-column gap.
measurementMethod.caveat: Mechanical suggestions only. Foot contact geometry and action timing require playback review; no fit-to-height scaling.

actionReview.requested: Tracker2010 raises high guard, absorbs a blocked impact, recovers.
actionReview.observed: Ready, raised forearms, high guard, backward compression, recovery and ready return are visible. Frames2/3 are close, frame4 is the clearest absorption pose.
actionReview.recommendation: Treat as guard entry1-3, optional held frame3, blocked-hit reaction4-5, return6; do not loop impacts as an idle.
limits: Actual playback/transition timing not verified here
Pose2/3 difference is small; not a locomotion clip
Caster in frame4 can be hidden by ordinary overlap
Mask proportions and blade projection are not a1:1 film match

notes: Selected PNG is tracker-guard-absorb-v2.png, generated solely through integrated OpenAI correction. Original tracker-guard-absorb.png is retained as rejected equipment draft.
No creative script retouching or source overwrite. Source RGB PNG bytes reconstructed from integrated dataURL and SHA verified.
Read-only official Hot Toys/Sideshow browser references were inspected before generation; V5 two-blade/netting approximations were not treated as canon.
Body heights392-438px exceed the requested340px maximum; silhouettes remain complete and frame rectangles do not overlap. No per-frame rescaling.
Near-foot width65-66px is stable across poses; source sheet placement drifts and is corrected only by pivots at one constant scale.
Magenta is opaque and nonuniform despite the prompt. No checkerboard observed. Color-key rendering and final hand/edge review remain runtime work.
Self-review supports usable-for-review after registration, not gameplay approval, anatomy certification or global1:1 fidelity.

actionReview.requested: Armored Fugitive2018: impact from screen right followed by recovery, six-frame one-shot.
actionReview.observed: Ready, backward recoil, maximum extension, low forward crouch, rising recovery and ready return are visually distinguishable. This is a hit-reaction candidate rather than a repeated idle.
actionReview.recommendation: One-shot frames1-6 then return to a separate ready/guard state. Do not loop impacts as an idle. Test timing at the3-to4 torso reversal.
limits: Runtime playback and combat readability not verified here
Near hand opens in frame3 although prompt asked curled fists throughout; plausible response, explicit deviation
Perspective/contact thresholds shift the far foot contact midpoint; pivot is a measured proposal
Mask and exact wrist blade dimensions are adapted, no1:1 claim

notes: Source bitmap preserved verbatim from integrated OpenAI generation dataURL; no API key, no alpha conversion, no creative script edits.
Six silhouettes found using full-width row projection; regular512px cells are reference guides only.
Fugitive full armor/biomask variant2018; not Lab Escape, Assassin or Predator Killer. Official NECA reference screenshots were inspected.
Figures occupy345-431px in height rather than requested350px maximum, and margins are smaller than requested. Do not fit each frame to equal height.
Use one constant sprite scale. The height reduction in recoil/crouch comes from posture, not a request for rescaling.
Status remains draft-registration-only / usable for visual review, not gameplay-approved or anatomy/cinema-fidelity certified.
Actual background samples: corners232,11,237 /240,16,240 /229,33,235 /234,28,236; gutter247,4,250. Opaque nonuniform magenta, no fake checkerboard observed.
